svg.title: The Known Galaxy: layout sketch v1
svg.desc: Rough layout sketch for author review, 2026-10-29. Radial memory-density layout: Mnemosyne Lattice Core at center, Helios Drift belt touching the Core, with an inner sleeve, a mid-sleeve and an outer sleeve of nine numbered sleeves, Lattice Gap as an outward rift with the Heliodrome at its epicenter, Remnant Seas pockets, scattered Void Regions, and the Black Horizon perimeter. Topology follows the accepted decisions; all geometry is approximate.
